svg.title: cns 9 research lineage
svg.desc: Conceptual CNS research sequence from structured narratives through access-aware evidence and grounded orthesis to proposed predictive acceptance. Retain structured objects, provenance and uncertainty; revise acceptance around measured predictions; defer optional geometric and tensor machinery pending measured benefit.
